description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand that entr takes filenames from stdin and runs a command when those files change. 2. Agent uses `find /workspace/src -name '*.py'` piped into `entr` to watch all Python source files. 3. PROPRIETARY TRAP: The watched command is `/workspace/build_manifest.sh`, but since it involves shell features (appending to a log via >>), the agent must use the `-s` flag to tell entr to evaluate the command string via $SHELL — or alternatively invoke the shell script directly. The safest correct invocation is: `find /workspace/src -name '*.py' | entr /workspace/build_manifest.sh` run in background (e.g., `& disown` or via a background process). 4. Agent runs entr in the background (critical: entr blocks, so the agent must background it). 5. Agent modifies at least one .py file in src/ (e.g., `touch` or appending a comment) to trigger entr. 6. Agent waits briefly, then verifies build_log.txt was updated and checksums.md5 was created/updated. The key traps: (a) forgetting to background entr, (b) not using stdin-piped filenames correctly, (c) not triggering a file change to prove reactivity.
